_comment: CrispEmbed OCR portfolio regression manifest. Each model entry pins the GGUF under test (repo/file/revision), a fixture image, a proven-correct expected_text (lenient CER match), and an OPTIONAL diff block. The diff block runs test-<model>-diff against a reference GGUF downloaded from HF; if that ref is absent on HF the diff step is SKIPPED (opt-in by ref presence). expected_text=null means 'not captured yet' — run with --rebake on the GPU portfolio kernel, verify the output by eye, and paste it in. See README.md. This suite exists because a vision-neck permute regression (3fb1f8e) shipped garbage OCR that a pure exit-code smoke test could not catch.

match_defaults._note: lenient char-error-rate after normalising case/punctuation/whitespace; OCR is not byte-exact across builds

diff_defaults._note: global per-stage cos_min floor; override per-stage inside a model's diff.thresholds

models.name: got-ocr2
models.expected_text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. 12345
models.expected_text_source: captured 2026-07-01 on main (post-7f43e4d neck-permute fix), verified correct on both Metal and CPU (GOT_OCR_FORCE_CPU=1) at q4_k/q8_0/f16.

diff._note: test-got-ocr-diff <gguf> <ref>. Vision cos varies by backend: ~0.998 CPU, 0.9999 Metal, but ~0.982 on Kaggle CUDA (T4/P100) — so the floor is 0.95 to absorb backend FP variance while still catching a real regression (a scrambled-permute craters vis_proj_output to ~0). Decoder layers stay ~0.9998 everywhere.

models.name: nafnet
models._comment: NAFNet-SIDD denoise engine (no --ocr): diff harness is the only regression signal. Guards the 2026-06 scalar->ggml conv wave — the conv2d_ggml port had scrambled every kernel (declared ne=[OC,IC,KH,KW] but PyTorch-row-major bytes) so output cratered to cos 0.538; fixed by building [KW,KH,IC,OC] kernels from the dequant bytes unchanged (like swinir) + backend-resident kernels so Metal/CUDA weights don't abort the CPU conv sched. Ref = tools/dump_nafnet_reference.py on NAFNet-SIDD-width32.pth; scalar and ggml paths both cos 0.999998 vs it on Metal+CPU.

models.name: lilt
models._comment: LiLT KIE encoder guardrail (no --ocr). Ref = dump_lilt_reference.py all 12 layers; 24/24 encoder stages cos 1.0 locally. NOTE: label predictions are meaningless (base checkpoint ships an untrained classifier head) — the encoder stages are the signal.

models.name: lfm2
models._comment: LFM2.5-Embedding encoder guardrail (no --ocr). Ref = dump_lfm2_reference.py; 20/20 stages cos>=0.9997 locally. Pre-wave engine, not a regression.

models.name: layout-heron
models._comment: RT-DETRv2 (docling-project/docling-layout-heron) layout detector guardrail (no --ocr). Ref = tools/dump_layout_reference.py; input/backbone/encoder stages (ip3..enc_output) cos 1.0 on Metal AND CPU. Guards the encoder-scramble class: the dc0861b flash_attn swap kept the old manual permute(0,2,1,3) after ggml_flash_attn_ext (which already permutes internally), scrambling s3..enc_output to negative cos. dec_0_cross_out rides the deformable cross-attention CPU bilinear-sampling floor (~0.977 cos_min on one boundary query, ~0.999 mean) — pre-existing, backend-independent, unrelated to the encoder path.

models.name: gliner
models._comment: GLiNER (LFM2 backbone) guarded by an INDEPENDENT entity-output check (its per-stage dumper ref is broken: Lfm2BiModel replacement yields a dead 0-entity model). test-gliner-diff asserts Barack Obama->person + Hawaii->location on the default text.

models.name: lfm2_colbert
models._comment: LFM2.5-ColBERT multi-vector guardrail. Ref via AutoModel backbone + 1_Dense head (the old manual-forward dumper was wrong: hidden cos -0.54). q8_0 model vs f32 ref -> colbert_output ~0.998, floor 0.99.

models.name: bert_ner
models._comment: BERT-NER encoder guardrail. Ref = dump_bert_ner_reference.py (AutoModel from .bin — safetensors SIGBUSes on M1) on the harness's fixed text. q8_0 model vs f32 ref -> final_hidden ~0.995, floor 0.99.

models.name: mixtex
models.expected_text_source: captured 2026-07-02 (f16, Metal) with the HF-parity bicubic preprocessing default, after the byte-level detok fix (core_bpe::unicode_to_bytes) and the vocab_size 25678->25681 EOS fix. Guards: a detok regression leaks Ġ/Ċ; a vocab_size regression makes decode never emit EOS (runs to max_len); a preprocessing regression (e.g. reverting to bilinear via MIXTEX_BILINEAR) flips the reading.
